outcome: A card cast with morph is a 2/2 face-down creature with no name, text, subtypes or mana cost, and its caster pays {3} instead of its mana cost.
A megamorph permanent turned face up by paying its cost gets a +1/+1 counter; a morph turned up gets none.
The morph spell resolves into a 2/2 face-down permanent with the face-down characteristics, which end when it is turned face up.
A card can be cast face down only through a morph ability.
Turning a face-down permanent face up restores its characteristics and enters-the-battlefield abilities do not trigger.
Abilities of the permanent that refer to X use the X paid for the morph cost when it is turned face up.
